critical_code_review_comments: OnboardingFunnelContext.markCompleted() at line 164 sets completedAt to `new Date().toISOString()` (ISO string), not `Date.now()` epoch as the review request specifies. Functionally equivalent because readHasCompletedFunnel() at line 97 only does a truthy check (`Boolean(parsed?.completedAt)`), but the type union `completedAt?: string` should be confirmed consistent everywhere it is read. PASS-with-note.

workout-session.tsx contains a duplicated heart-rate streaming useEffect block (lines 138-175 and 200-243). The second block references `setHrSampleCount` which doesn't exist as state (pre-existing TS error the user is already aware of). Recommend deduplicating; one HR subscribe call is enough and the second creates two parallel subscriptions on mount.

workout-session.tsx line 327 reads `firstWorkout?.moodCard` but the SessionWorkout interface (lines 44-55) does not declare a `moodCard` field — silent undefined. Not new from this changeset but worth a follow-up.

FunnelEntryGate self-heal is correct, but the `dispatched.current` latch (line 44) is set to true in BOTH the completed-bail branch (line 61) and the route-replace branch (line 65). Good — prevents redundant re-checks within the session.

Behavior cannot be reproduced in Expo web (requires real app kills+relaunches with persisted AsyncStorage). If runtime test needed, simulate via `window.localStorage` manipulation in web preview: set `@mood_needs_funnel='true'` and `@mood_funnel_answers_v1='{"completedAt":"2026-01-15T00:00:00.000Z"}'`, then verify FunnelEntryGate purges the flag without routing back into the funnel.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: after a returning user logged out and someone else registered (or after a crash mid-register), `@mood_needs_funnel='true'` could survive while `@mood_funnel_answers_v1.completedAt` was already set from a prior session, causing the already-onboarded user to be re-routed into the 8-step funnel on next launch. Fix layers: (1) logout() now nukes both keys defensively; (2) FunnelEntryGate self-heals if completedAt exists; (3) handleGetStarted double-checks completedAt before pushing into funnel and always clears the flag. Stage 3 paywall fix: `recordStartFreeWorkout()` moved from start-tap to completion path so users who bail mid-workout don't lose their free session — paywall still fires on workout #2 because the flag flips on completion before the next start tap.
